description: Independent Java replacement expansion and optional position controls for #774. Results must be captured from Spark.

sql: SELECT regexp_replace(s,re,replacement) AS r FROM rr_valid ORDER BY k

'Sort ['k ASC NULLS FIRST], true
+- 'Project [regexp_replace(s#1, re#2, replacement#3, k#0) AS r#104]
   +- SubqueryAlias rr_valid
      +- View (`rr_valid`, [k#0, s#1, re#2, replacement#3])
         +- LogicalRDD [k#0, s#1, re#2, replacement#3], false
